chunks: Ayyūb ibn Nūḥ narrated to me from al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb, from ʿAlāʾ, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:

Regarding a woman from whom the blood—the blood of menstruation—ceases at the end of her days, he said: “If her husband is overcome by desire, then let her wash her private part, then her husband may touch her, if he wishes, before she performs ghusl (ritual bath).”

key_terms.الدَّمُ: the blood that had been flowing and then ceased
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةُ: the woman being asked about in the legal ruling

ai.seo_question: Can a husband approach his wife after menstruation ends but before she performs ghusl (ritual bath)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling concerning a woman whose menstrual blood has ceased at the end of her period. It states that if the husband has strong desire, she may wash her private part and he may approach her before she performs ghusl (ritual bath).
